Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly calculated the atomic mass by summing up protons, neutrons, and electrons (20 + 21 + 20 = 61), instead of summing only protons and neutrons (20 + 21 = 41). The atomic mass is determined by the sum of protons and neutrons, as electrons have negligible mass. This fundamental error in understanding the concept of atomic mass led to the selection of the incorrect answer (D) instead of the correct answer (C).
